scope: PS3-only package, file-transfer, browser and archive workflows. Primary project evidence; no claim of testing on PS3 hardware.

sources.finding: The hub navigation distinguishes PS3 mods, HEN/CFW and game-region resources. Its links are discovery evidence, not independent compatibility validation.
webMAN MOD exposes an HTTP file manager and documented download commands. Current commands use /xmb.ps3/download.ps3. Download and install endpoints have different effects.
File/web/FTP service features, external-storage support and experimental archive extraction are documented. Extraction via its integration requires PKGLAUNCH and app_home/PS3_GAME.

PS3 native FTP/SMB/NFS/WebDAV/HTTP client; supports HTTP HTML directory listings, GitHub release browsing, local file operations and archive extraction. Remote PKG workflow creates a Package Manager install bubble; background tasks need reboot.

PS3 native package downloader; custom catalogues, SHA256 checksum field, direct/background modes, resume; background tasks appear after reboot. It does not turn arbitrary RAR/SPRX into installable packages.
The 1.41 release offers a separate FileManager_v1.41.pkg console build and ManaGunZ_v1.41.pkg. FileManager release MD5 is 7693629675c2f4d3f8986bae1c314903; archive records SHA256 independently.

Experimental PS3 HEN archive tool. Developer explicitly says no real hardware validation. ZIP and supported 7z extraction implemented; RAR extraction is not listed. TAR/GZ/BZ2/XZ are detection only; copy/move/rename/delete and archive creation are not yet implemented.
Documents built-in browser operation. This is not evidence that modern file hosts, TLS, JavaScript or every attachment type work on a PS3.

resources.name: PS3 Archive Manager · experimental
resources.compatibility: Experimental HEN project; developer reports no real-hardware validation. ZIP and supported 7z only; RAR extraction not supported by this project.
resources.description: An optional experimental archive tool with split ZIP/7z volume checks. Prefer the documented ezRemote route for RAR extraction. Detection of TAR/GZ/BZ2/XZ does not mean it can extract those formats.

browserWorkflow.default: Use a short static PS3-only list with ordinary attachment links. Downloading a file is separate from extracting an archive, installing a PKG and running homebrew.

webman.requires: A supported CFW/HEN setup with webMAN MOD already installed and its HTTP service running. Enable HEN after boot where required.
webman.installWarning: /xmb.ps3/install_ps3?url= downloads and installs a PKG. Do not present that endpoint as download-only.
webman.network: Use the console LAN address from another device. localhost means the current device; a PC loopback preview URL is not reachable from PS3. Put a reachable HTTP/HTTPS file URL on a LAN host or public host. Browser mixed-content/TLS restrictions can prevent remote commands; provide an ordinary navigation link and manual instructions.

ezremote.remote: Set server to a reachable HTTP directory listing or supported FTP/SMB/NFS/WebDAV server. PS3 does not see the desktop F: path.
ezremote.extract: Choose a ZIP/RAR/7zip/TAR/TAR.GZ/TAR.BZ2 archive in ezRemote and use its extraction operation. Check free storage for both the preserved original and extracted files.
ezremote.install: After the documented remote-PKG operation, complete installation via the Package Manager bubble. SPRX, EBOOT, RPF and SCO require game-specific placement and compatibility; they are not generic PKG installation files.

pkgi.checksum: SHA256 is supported in the package catalogue checksum field.
pkgi.background: Tasks appear after reboot. Enable HEN again before launching homebrew if required.
pkgi.limit: Use PKGi for PKG packages from an explicitly configured catalogue. Do not label RAR, SPRX, Windows EXE, APK or Vita VPK as PS3-installable PKG files.

storage.fat32: FAT32 has a per-file limit below 4 GiB. A homebrew tool supporting NTFS/exFAT does not add those filesystems to the stock PS3 updater or Package Manager.
storage.space: Allow room for both compressed archive and extracted content; installing a PKG can require additional storage.
storage.separation: Original archives retained. Ready console builds remain separate from Windows RTM helper programs, source code and documentation.
